Ticket Description: I tried to pay for my plan and the payment failed, but the amount was deducted from my card 4111 1111 1111 1111. Please help.
Resolution: Confirmed a duplicate authorization hold. Voided the hold and asked the customer to allow 5 business days for the bank to release funds.

Ticket Subject: Charged twice for the same invoice
Ticket Description: I was charged twice for invoice 88213. My account number is ACC-3391045. Contact me at +1 (415) 555-0132.
Resolution: Located two identical charges from a client-side retry. Refunded the second charge and enabled idempotency keys on the account.

Ticket Description: I never receive the OTP SMS when logging in. I have tried three times. My number is 415-555-0177.
Resolution: Carrier filtering blocked the SMS sender ID. Switched the customer to the email OTP channel and raised a routing ticket with the SMS vendor.

Ticket Description: The one time password never arrives on my phone. Login is impossible. I already checked spam.
Resolution: Same carrier filtering issue as the known SMS routing incident. Moved the user to email OTP and confirmed successful login.

Ticket Description: Exporting the monthly report from the dashboard returns a 500 error. Trace id 9f2a-114c. URL https://app.example.com/export?report=monthly&user=884
Resolution: Export job exceeded the worker memory limit for accounts with more than 200k rows. Increased the worker tier and added pagination to the export.

Ticket Subject: Report export fails with server error
Ticket Description: Every time I export a report I get a server error 500. This has happened for three days.
Resolution: Duplicate of the export worker memory incident. Applied the same worker tier increase; export completed successfully.

Ticket Description: I want to add my team to the workspace but cannot find the invite screen.
Resolution: Walked the customer through Settings > Members > Invite. Sent the help centre article covering seat limits.

Ticket Description: Where is the option to invite team members? I am on the starter plan.
Resolution: Starter plan is capped at 3 seats and hides the invite button once the cap is reached. Explained the cap and shared upgrade options.

Ticket Description: Our webhook endpoint stopped receiving events on Tuesday. Endpoint https://hooks.acme.io/ingest?key=sk-live-9931aabbccddeeff
Resolution: Endpoint returned 403 for 24 hours so deliveries were auto-disabled. Rotated the signing secret, re-enabled the endpoint, and replayed the missed events.

Ticket Subject: Events not delivered to our endpoint
Ticket Description: We stopped receiving webhook events. No configuration changed on our side.
Resolution: Endpoint auto-disabled after repeated 5xx responses. Re-enabled after the customer fixed their listener and replayed 412 events.

Ticket Description: I was told a refund was issued 10 days ago but nothing has arrived in my account.
Resolution: Refund was issued to an expired card and bounced back to the merchant balance. Re-issued the refund to the current payment method.

Ticket Description: My subscription renewed even though I cancelled last month.
Resolution: Cancellation was submitted after the renewal cut-off window. Cancelled the new term and issued a prorated refund as a goodwill gesture.

Ticket Description: Signing in with SSO redirects back to the login page endlessly. We use Okta.
Resolution: The SAML assertion was missing the NameID attribute after the customer's IdP upgrade. Updated the attribute mapping in Okta and verified login.

Ticket Subject: SAML redirect loop after IdP change
Ticket Description: After our identity provider change users bounce between the app and the IdP without signing in.
Resolution: Same missing NameID assertion pattern. Corrected the IdP attribute statement and confirmed successful authentication for all affected users.

Ticket Description: Is there a way to have the weekly report emailed automatically?
Resolution: Scheduled reports are available on Business and above. Enabled the trial flag so the customer could evaluate the feature.

Ticket Description: How do I set up automatic weekly report emails to my team?
Resolution: Guided the customer through Reports > Schedule. Noted that recipients must be workspace members.

Ticket Description: Our integration hits rate limits after only a few requests. Using api_key sk-live-77ab99cc11dd22ee.
Resolution: Client was retrying without backoff, multiplying the request volume. Implemented exponential backoff and raised the burst limit for the account.

Ticket Description: We are getting 429 responses on nearly every API call since yesterday.
Resolution: Account had been auto-throttled after a traffic spike. Cleared the throttle and advised the customer on request batching.

Ticket Description: Our CSV import fails with a column mismatch error. The file has 12 columns.
Resolution: Header row contained a trailing empty column produced by Excel. Advised re-saving as UTF-8 CSV; import then succeeded.

Ticket Description: Uploading our customer CSV gives a column mismatch error every time.
Resolution: Same trailing-empty-column pattern from Excel exports. Customer re-saved the file and the import completed.

Ticket Description: The invoice PDF for {product_purchased} is missing the usage line items.
I request a password reset for {customer_name} and no email arrives.
All dashboard charts are blank in Safari 16 but fine in Chrome.
Our Zapier connection disconnects every night and must be re-authorised.
Can we extend our trial by two weeks while we finish evaluation?
Resolution: N/A

Ticket Description: Our invoices show no VAT even though we supplied a VAT number.
Resolution: resolved

Ticket Description: Users are logged out after about five minutes of activity. Server IP 10.44.12.9.
Resolution: Session cookie lifetime was overridden by a stale workspace security policy. Restored the default 12 hour lifetime.

Ticket Description: The analytics dashboard shows data that is six hours behind real time.
Resolution: Ingestion backlog caused by a stuck consumer group. Restarted the consumers and backfilled the delayed window.

Ticket Description: Every alert posts three times into our Slack channel.
Resolution: Three separate Slack integrations were installed against the same channel. Removed the two redundant installs.

Ticket Description: How do we request a sandbox environment for testing before go live?
Resolution: Provisioned a sandbox workspace and sent the API base URL and test credentials process.
